'''Urium Shades''' are [[undead]] [[spectral]] creatures who lurk behind the gold door in the [[Mort'ton]] [[Shade Catacombs|shade catacombs]] dungeon. They initially appear as moving shadows on the ground and then rise from the depths to attack or retaliate. Their [[Urium remains|remains]] can be cremated with [[redwood pyre logs]] as part of the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton minigame]], requiring a [[Firemaking]] level of 95. 

As with all [[Shades (Shades of Mort'ton)|shades in Mort'ton]], Urium shades possess 2 traits players should be aware of:

# A unique trait in which their [[Damage per second/Melee#Step seven: Calculate the hit chance|failed accuracy rolls]] do not count as combat; therefore actions usually restricted during combat can still be performed should this occur. Note that this also affects auto-retaliate, however they can still [[Successful_hit|successfully hit a 0]].
# A 1/20 chance to temporarily lower a player's [[Strength]] by 1 on a successful hit that inflicts damage, which can stack.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1698259314773733573|date=3 September 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/97631|archivedate=4 September 2023|quote=[Do shades in morton and the shades catacombs have a chance to drain strength? (...)] It's 1/20 if they're hitting >0 damage.}}.

Urium shades are aggressive but unlike other shades they will only occasionally target the player.

As Urium Shades are undead, they are susceptible to the effects of [[Crumble Undead]] and the [[Salve amulet]]. They are also weak to the [[Gadderhammer]], although a [[dragon scimitar]] deals more damage on average.
